title: Pets
summary: Five pets, one per skill: how to get them, rarities, stats, perks, levelling and the Pets page.

s.x: Pets are small companions that float at your shoulder and give you stats while they are out. There is one kind of pet for each of five skills, and your pet
levels up as you earn XP
in its skill. At levels 25 and 50 it unlocks a perk. You keep a collection of pets in storage and swap the one that is out whenever you like.
Every pet also gives
0.1 Insight per level
in its skill, times its rarity bonus: +5 at level 50 Common, +10 at level 50 Legendary.

A pet's level goes from 1 to 50. The XP it needs grows quickly: 250 times (level minus 1) squared in total, so level 10 is 20,250 XP, level 25 is 144,000 XP and level 50 is 600,250 XP.
Your active pet earns
25% of the XP you earn in its skill
, and
5% of the XP from other skills
Stored pets keep their level and XP, but do not earn any.
At level 25 and 50 you get a chat notice with the new perk. At level 50 it shows MAX LEVEL.
A pet earns XP while you play, so equip the pet for what you are about to do (a Mole for mining, an Otter for fishing). Switching is free, and the others keep what they have.
You keep your pets in
pet storage
, a saved list of 30 pets (the server can change this number).
Right-click a pet item
to move it into storage. If no pet is out, it also goes out.
Eggs hatch straight into storage. A full storage will not hatch an egg, so make room first.
The pet that is out floats over your shoulder for everyone to see.
Pet items already in your inventory stay items until you right-click them.

Open it from the SkyRPG menu (K). It shows a live 3D preview of the selected pet (it turns slowly and leans towards the mouse) with its rarity, name, level and XP bar. On the right you see its skill, stats and perks, then your
pet storage
with a count like
: a grid with the active pet (green mark) and every stored pet, with rarity border, icon, name and level.
Click a pet to select it, then use the buttons:
Equip
puts it out (the old pet goes back to its place in storage).
Unequip
puts the active pet back in storage.
Take out
moves it into your inventory as an item, to trade or give away. It is blocked while your inventory is full.

rows.x: Operators only: adds a pet to someone's storage

s.x: The pet is a real 3D model beside your right shoulder, for everyone, in third person and in the inventory and K-menu previews. Each kind has its own look: the Mole wears a miner's helmet with a lamp, the Bumblebee has fuzzy translucent wings, the Owl has big eyes and ear tufts, the Wolf Pup has floppy ears and a wagging tail, and the Otter holds a pebble or a fish.

Rarity changes the look too: Common is plain, Uncommon and Rare change colours and add small accessories (a flower, a bandana, a sprig, a pickaxe, goggles), Epic adds a bigger accessory, and Legendary adds a crown or halo and a glow. A pet also gives off a rarity-coloured aura for nearby players. It trails slightly behind you when you move and leans into the movement.
